تملغمت (form IIq)
# تَمَلْغَمْتُ (tamalḡamtu) /ta.mal.ɣam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَمَلْغَمَ (tamalḡama)
# تَمَلْغَمْتَ (tamalḡamta) /ta.mal.ɣam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَمَلْغَمَ (tamalḡama)
# تَمَلْغَمْتِ (tamalḡamti) /ta.mal.ɣam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَمَلْغَمَ (tamalḡama)
# تَمَلْغَمَتْ (tamalḡamat) /ta.mal.ɣa.mat/: t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
